title: Drift Says When, Budget Says How Much: Rate-Controlled KV Re-selection for Long-Form Multimodal Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.31433v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: KV cache compression for multimodal LLMs usually selects the visual tokens to keep once, at prefill, and reuses that selection for the whole generation. We show that this one-shot selection is severely limited on long-form generation: on detailed image description, even an oracle that selects with the attention of the uncompressed answer reaches only 0.44-0.52 ROUGE-L agreement with the uncompressed output, because the evidence the model reads moves as the description unfolds. Re-selecting whenever attention drifts out of the kept set is the natural remedy, but we find that a fixed drift threshold fails systematically: drift magnitudes are not comparable across samples, so low-drift samples are almost never refreshed although they benefit the most. We propose Rate-Controlled Refresh (RCR), which lets drift decide when and where to re-select while a per-sample controller regulates how often, combined with a low-rank drift detector, candid

translated_title: 漂移决定时机，预算决定数量：面向长篇多模态生成的速率受控KV重选
translated_abstract: 面向多模态大语言模型的KV缓存压缩通常在预填充阶段一次性选出需保留的视觉token，并在整个生成过程中复用这一选择。我们证明这种一次性选择在长篇生成任务上存在严重局限：在详细图像描述任务上，即使是使用未压缩答案的注意力进行选择的oracle，与未压缩输出的ROUGE-L一致性也仅为0.44-0.52，因为模型读取的证据会随着描述的展开而不断变化。每当注意力漂移出保留集合时重新选择是自然的补救办法，但我们发现固定的漂移阈值会系统性地失效：漂移幅度在不同样本之间不可比，导致低漂移样本几乎从不刷新，尽管它们恰恰受益最大。我们提出速率受控刷新（Rate-Controlled Refresh, RCR），由漂移决定何时何地重新选择，同时由逐样本控制器调节刷新频率，并结合低秩漂移检测器……（摘要截断）
tldr: 提出速率受控刷新（RCR）方法，用注意力漂移决定KV缓存视觉token何时重选、用逐样本控制器调节刷新频率，从而显著提升多模态大模型长篇生成的质量。
en_tdlr: Proposes Rate-Controlled Refresh (RCR), which lets attention drift decide when to re-select KV cache visual tokens while a per-sample controller regulates refresh frequency, substantially improving long-form multimodal generation quality.
